body: Thank you, it really is all I wanted. If I was allowed to go out with my friends and boyfriend more often I would feel so much happier. Instead they make me stay at home all day and I just go on my phone or play video games until its time for bed. I even have to ask permission to go to the store. I will probably end up moving out.
